title: processkit file change
description: One entry of a write plan or of a change report (repository-storage@v1 PK-STORE-021, PK-STORE-057). A plan or report is an array of entries sorted by path in ascending Unicode code point order, with each path at most once.

path.description: Path of the file relative to the repository root, with / as separator, normalized (no . or .. segments, no leading or trailing /).

action.description: create: the file did not exist before the command. replace: an existing file gets new content. delete: an existing file is removed. replace and delete require confirmation (PK-STORE-022, cli@v1 PK-CLI-014).

digest_before.description: SHA-256 of the file's bytes before the command; null for create.

digest_after.description: SHA-256 of the file's bytes after the command; null for delete.
